prompt: In a photorealistic photo, the golden wheat field stretches under a bright sky. On the far left, a farmer in a straw hat stands tall, holding a sharp scythe. Next to him, a rusted metal bucket sits on the dry earth. A black crow perches on the bucket's rim, looking toward the center. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue apron bends over, gathering stalks with gloved hands. Beside her, a young boy in suspenders points at a large sheaf of wheat. The sheaf rests against a wooden crate filled with grain. A brown dog lies next to the crate, panting heavily. Behind them, an old tractor with peeling paint is parked, its engine silent. A man in a red scarf leans against the tractor's tire, wiping sweat from his brow. To his right, a white goat chews on a stray stalk of hay. Further back on the right, three workers in denim overalls form a line. The first worker passes a bundle to the second, who hands it to the third. A stack of tied bundles grows beside the third worker. Above them, a hawk circles in the distant blue sky. Near the tractor's front wheel, a green watering can tips slightly. A small child in a yellow dress sits on a low stone wall, watching the scene. A tabby cat sleeps on the wall next to the child. An elderly woman in a floral dress stands near the stone wall, shielding her eyes from the sun. She looks at the woman in the blue apron. A woven basket hangs from the elderly woman's arm. A pair of leather boots lies abandoned near the rusted bucket. There is no modern machinery visible in the background. There is no rain or cloud cover obscuring the sun. There is no fence separating the field from the horizon.
